items.title: Oil prices rise sharply as investors seek progress on U.S.-Iran talks
items.description: Oil rose Thursday, as traders assess a report that Asia is on track to import its highest volume of crude oil since the start of the US-Iran war.

items.title: Global debt tops $365 trillion as economists sound alarm over 'vicious cycle'
items.description: More is being paid out by advanced economies in debt interest than the whole world spends on AI, defense or clean technology.

items.title: Switzerland is keeping rates at 0% — for now
items.description: The Swiss National Bank held rates at 0% as low inflation and a strong franc enable it to diverge from other central banks, though markets expect hikes ahead.

items.title: Treasury yields continue to rise after 10-year hit 19-year high as investors ramp-up rate hike bets
items.description: U.S. Treasury yields continued their upward momentum after hitting a 19-year high on Wednesday.

items.title: Tehran criticizes Canada for not condemning Trump's threat to destroy Iran
items.description: Baqaei said that Carney chose to appease Washington by reframing a threat to "annihilate" Iran as merely "speaking the language of war."

items.title: Judge lifts Trump ban on CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House
items.description: District Judge Tim Kelly said the three outlets should have their access immediately restored from the ban that the president had announced on Sept. 18.

items.title: France's fresh budget battle threatens to topple another government
items.description: Time is not on the side of French government bonds, strategists have warned, as the nation's deficit balloons.

items.title: Novo's new strategy hinges on something it can't manufacture: investor trust
items.description: Novo has now reached the point where it can broaden its ambitions again, CEO Mike Doustdar told CNBC, but investors remain unconvinced.

items.title: Miami's ultra-luxury housing market booms as cash transactions dominate, high-end brands like Bugatti and Porsche jump in
items.description: Miami’s ultra-luxury housing segment is booming even as the broader market cools. UBS sees a declining risk of a bubble.

items.title: Judge hears arguments on Trump White House media ban, hopes to rule 'soon'
items.description: The DOJ on Tuesday night cited national security concerns in justifying President Trump's ban of MS NOW, CNN and Politico from the White House.

items.title: U.S.-China trade truce extended for two months, Bessent says, as Xi begins state visit
items.description: The deal, which was set to expire in November, will now be extended to Jan. 10, Bessent said, noting the need for Beijing to fulfill more deliverables.

items.title: OpenAI says agent hacked Australian government website without being told to do so
items.description: An OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access to an Australian government website while attempting to gather health data.

items.title: Historic day for global bonds as 10-year Treasury and JGB yields hit highest in decades
items.description: Japanese 10-year government bond yield rose to a 30-year high on Thursday, following a surge in Treasury yields.

items.title: World heads into food crises 'blind' as U.S. aid cuts squeeze UN food agency, experts warn
items.description: Climate shocks, conflict and a global fuel crisis, on top of surging interest rates and donor cuts, leave agencies less able to help those facing higher food prices.

items.title: China's AI chip blitz arms Xi with a message for Trump: 'You can't choke us off'
items.description: A run of new chips and AI models from national champions gives Chinese President Xi Jinping a confidence boost, as the U.S. summit gets underway.

items.title: Here's what happens to the economy when Treasury yields soar like they are now
items.description: Government debt costs leaped higher Wednesday, the product of multiple factors.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg debuts $1,299 Meta VR Glasses and Muse Charm pendant as part of AI agent push
items.description: At Meta Connect, CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed new VR Glasses and the Muse Charm gadget for AI agents.

items.title: America’s Asian allies want a Trump-Xi truce — but not at their expense
items.description: There are concerns that Trump could soften Washington's position on Taiwan or other regional security issues in return for concessions from Beijing.

items.title: Chinese authorities reportedly in possession of F-35 components in Hong Kong
items.description: Shipping giant UPS was sending a cockpit canopy and weapons bay door to the U.S. from Australia in late May when it was diverted to Hong Kong.

items.title: Inside India newsletter: Apple set to take a bigger bite of the world’s second-largest smartphone market
items.description: Apple's latest iPhone launch will boost its market share in India at a time when many incumbent Chinese brands that dominate the market are struggling to sell.
